company_overview: Supabase provides an open-source, production-grade backend platform centered on PostgreSQL, offering built-in authentication, instant REST APIs, real-time data, edge functions, storage, and vector embeddings. Unlike traditional serverless infrastructure providers, Supabase emphasizes developer productivity by consolidating best-of-breed products into a single integrated dashboard that is fully portable and deeply compatible with the Postgres ecosystem.
target_audience: Software developers and engineering teams building production-grade web and mobile applications that require a full backend (database, auth, storage, APIs, real-time, and AI/vector features) without managing individual infrastructure services.

company_overview: Vapi is a platform that enables developers and businesses to build, test, and deploy AI-powered voice agents for customer support, lead qualification, appointment scheduling, and other use cases. Notable for its enterprise-grade infrastructure (sub-500ms latency, HIPAA/SOC 2/PCI compliance, AI guardrails) and rapid deployment — customers have gone "zero to production in two weeks," with 2.5M+ agents launched and 1M+ developers on the platform.
target_audience: Developers and companies building conversational voice AI agents, from startups to enterprise/Fortune 100 organizations handling high-volume call operations in support, lead qualification, scheduling, and staffing.

company_overview: Resend is an email infrastructure platform that enables developers to deliver transactional and marketing emails at scale through a developer-first API, SDKs, and a React-based visual editor. Notable for its "developer experience" focus, it powers email templates via the open-source react-email library and is trusted by companies of all sizes for high-deliverability email sending.
target_audience: Software developers and engineering teams building applications that require transactional, onboarding, or marketing email delivery; also marketing teams managing newsletters and campaigns.

company_overview: Sentry is an error monitoring and performance monitoring platform that helps developers and software teams identify, debug, and fix code issues in real time, with connected logs, replays, and AI-assisted debugging. It stands out for its developer-first approach—minimal five-line SDK setup, a single unified trace across all signals, and AI features like Seer that auto-generate merge-ready patches and review code.
target_audience: Developers and software engineering teams building applications across web, mobile, and backend platforms (Next.js, React, Python, Node.js, .NET, Swift, etc.)
